title: Company Secretary Service
intro: We provide comprehensive company secretary services to ensure your business remains fully compliant with all statutory obligations and governance requirements.
includes: Free Confirmation Statement filing with fee
Address essential aspects like add/remove directors, dissolution and more at no cost.
Make up to 10 changes to your company on yearly basis without any charges
Maintaining appointments and resignation of company officers
Notifying filing deadlines and changes in policies of Company House & HMRC
A dedicated secretary taking care of compliance seriously.
A dedicated account manager to answer all your questions & process your instructions carefully.
Online company manager to manage everything at one place
body: At Brixen Consultants, you can avail of the best full company secretary service that includes a company secretary and a dedicated and efficient account manager who will take care of the entire statutory registers, make changes in the company as per your instructions and prepare and file company’s confirmation statement.

This service proves extremely helpful for companies as it provides peace of mind that the company’s secretarial aspects are well taken care of as well as ensures the company’s records are up-to-date and compliant. The professionals at Brixen Consultants provide many other important services such as UK company registration service, dissolution service, etc.

Your professional account manager will be responsible for preparing and filing annual confirmation statements including Companies House filing fees. He/she will also have the duty of preparing and maintaining ten statutory registers as they are required by the Companies Act of 2006.
Once you take our services, your account manager will appoint our corporate secretary.
He will be responsible for managing everything the right way.
Your professional account manager will be responsible for preparing and maintaining company registers for your utmost convenience.
If you need a copy of any document immediately, we will provide it to you through email.
Our professional account manager will always be ready to answer all your queries, maintain registers, carry out charges and deliver copies on request and thereby file the confirmation statement.

Our offered full company secretary service is affordable and if you are satisfied with our offered services, you can renew it on annual basis. You will be notified in advance of the renewal date and you will possess the right to cancel our services at any time you want.

**Note : **Depending on the type of company you own (Private Limited, LLP,PLC,Limited by guarantee,Non-UK Resident), different legal obligations apply. In order for us to help you with the right solution catered to your company’s needs, we advise you to get in touch with us.
